summary.text: Rui Pinto de Andrade (Luanda, 23 de septiembre de 1999) es un piloto de automovilismo angoleño-portugués. Ha destacado en carreras de resistencia de la categoría LMP2, logrando victorias en el Campeonato Mundial de Resistencia de la FIA y WeatherTech SportsCar Championship.

summary.text: Thomas C. Annunziata (born June 14, 2005) is an American professional stock car racing driver. He last competed full-time in the ARCA Menards Series, driving the No. 70 Toyota Camry for Nitro Motorsports and part-time in the NASCAR Craftsman Truck Series, driving the No. 1/5 Toyota Tundra TRD Pro for Tricon Garage. He has previously competed in the NASCAR O'Reilly Auto Parts Series.

Ralf Aron (Tallin, Estonia, 21 de marzo de 1998) es un piloto de automovilismo estonio.

Compitió en el Campeonato Europeo de Fórmula 3 de la FIA y el Gran Premio de Macao en 2017 y 2018.

Casper Stevenson (born 22 April 2003) is a British racing driver competing in the IMSA SportsCar Championship for DragonSpeed.

Stevenson has primarily raced for Aston Martin customer teams in GT3. These include D'station Racing in the FIA World Endurance Championship, where he scored an LMGTE Am podium in 2023, and The Heart of Racing in IMSA, where he came third in the GTD standings in 2025. Previously in his single-seater career, he was Euroformula Open rookies' champion in 2021, and third in the F4 British Championship in 2020.

summary.text: Fabian "Fabs" Coulthard (born 28 July 1982) is a New Zealand professional race car driver, currently competing in the Repco Supercars Championship, who drives as an endurance co-driver for Chaz Mostert with Walkinshaw TWG Racing. Fabian is a second cousin of former Formula One driver David Coulthard.

summary.text: Daniel Holgado Miralles (San Vicente del Raspeig, Alicante, 27 de abril de 2005) es un piloto de motociclismo español. Actualmente compite en el Campeonato del Mundo de Motociclismo de Moto2 con el CFMoto Aspar Team, tras resultar subcampeón de Moto3 en 2024. Fue campeón del FIM CEV Moto3 Junior World Championship con el Aspar Junior Team y tercero de la Red Bull MotoGP Rookies Cup en 2021. En 2027 dará el salto a la categoría de MotoGP con Gresini Racing.
Dawson Sutton (born January 28, 2006) is an American professional stock car racing driver. He competes full-time in the NASCAR Truck Series, driving the No. 5 Toyota Tundra TRD Pro for Tricon Garage.

Kyle Robert Kelley (born June 28, 1985) is an American professional sports car racing driver in the Trans-Am Series' TA2 class. He has also competed in the NASCAR O'Reilly Auto Parts Series, having previously competed in the series from 2010 to 2026 as a road course ringer.

summary.text: Tyler B. Majeski (Seymour, Wisconsin, Estados Unidos; 18 de agosto de 1994), más conocido como Ty Majeski, es un piloto estadounidense de automovilismo. Se ha desempeñado en carreras de stock cars. Actualmente compite a tiempo parcial en la NASCAR Truck Series para el equipo ThorSport Racing, para el que también trabaja como ingeniero.

Victor Martins (Varennes-Jarcy, Francia; 16 de junio de 2001) es un piloto de automovilismo francés. Fue campeón del Campeonato Mundial de Karting en 2016. Entre 2018 y 2025 formó parte de la Academia Alpine (anteriormente Renault Sport), siendo campeón de la Eurocopa de Fórmula Renault en 2020 y subcampeón en 2019. En su segundo año en el Campeonato de Fórmula 3 de la FIA se coronó campeón. En 2026 es piloto oficial de Alpine en el Campeonato Mundial de Resistencia de la FIA en la categoría Hypercar.

Rafael Villagómez Jr. (born 10 November 2001) is a Mexican racing driver who competes in the FIA Formula 2 Championship for Van Amersfoort Racing.

Villagómez previously competed in the FIA Formula 3 Championship for three seasons. He won the Richard Mille Young Talent Academy competition in 2019.

Steven William Thomas (born July 12, 1967) is an American attorney at TAFS and amateur racing driver. As a gentleman driver, Thomas has competed in endurance events such as the FIA World Endurance Championship, WeatherTech SportsCar Championship, IMSA Prototype Challenge and Michelin Le Mans Cup.
